issue_context.title: Pool temperature sensor not available
issue_context.body:
### The problem

The sensor for the pool temperature is N/A. if I add it with modbus it works(address 27). In the documentation for the Pool 40 system it is located under CL11-BT51 while in the integration only CL12-BT51 is available which gives the N/A value.

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

2023.2.2

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

Home Assistant OS

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/nibe_heatpump/
